title: Kairos
description: A minecraft mod to enhance the sky. no shaders required.
body:
Kairos is a minecraft mod that aims to enhance the day and night sky without overshadowing the game itself. I aimed to create something to minorly change how it looks and make it look a little more dynamic and vivid. If you are lucky, you might encounter a meteor shower at night, or a very vibrant night time sky. 

Let me know of any bugs/suggestions in my discord server!

Enjoy the mod, and enjoy the view.
